title: Utility walk curing selection

source_context.document_identity: UFGS 32 16 19 — Concrete Sidewalks, Curbs and Gutters; May 2018; downloaded edition references UMRL July 2026
source_context.note: Curing materials include sheeting and membrane compound.
source_context.use: Factual paraphrase of a guide specification, not a project requirement unless adopted in synthetic records.

paragraphs.text: Use white-pigmented curing compound for the utility walk, as in the early schedule.
A future applied finish is being discussed. No finish is ordered yet; the owner wants to avoid assuming compatibility of a compound with that possible finish.

Meeting note: the caretaker suggested doing the walk together with a later storage-pad project. The owner declined to combine the orders because the storage-pad dimensions are still being discussed. A sample of clear sealer was left on the meeting table by another supplier; it was not tested, selected or bought. The only question reopened by the owner was the curing method, and the subsequent numbered amendments record that choice. Existing white marks on the old walkway are traffic paint, not evidence of the proposed curing system.

Delivery discussion: the supplier's packing list uses 'membrane' as a generic heading covering several curing products. The estimator will use the specific owner selection when ordering, rather than treating that heading as permission to change products. The office has asked that delivery vehicles report to reception. Reception hours are background coordination information and no special delivery charge or additional construction task has been agreed in this fictional record. The future finish has no confirmed date, product or area and remains a separate prospective order.
Amendment 1: hold the curing choice pending the finish discussion. Do not order compound this week.
Amendment 2: use white opaque impervious sheeting for curing instead of membrane compound. This replaces the early schedule; there is still no applied finish in this order.
Cure utility-walk concrete with white opaque impervious sheeting. No membrane compound or future applied finish included.
